department: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences (BCS)

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026, 11:59 PM US Eastern (application opens September 1). English-test waiver requests close November 25.
deadline.quote: Deadline: December 1 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time

gre_general.value: BCS does not accept GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: BCS does not accept GRE scores and will not consider GRE scores in the evaluation of your application.

gre_subject.value: The Psychology Subject GRE is not considered either.
gre_subject.quote: Scores sent to MIT will not be reviewed during application review.

english_waiver.value: BCS accepts a waiver request if you earned a degree from an English-medium institution in any country, including India; you must upload proof such as an official medium-of-instruction letter, by November 25.
english_waiver.quote: You have earned a degree from an institution where the language of instruction is English (this applies regardless of the country in which the institution is located). | Please plan to submit documentation, such as an official MOI from your institution or verification of your residency, in order to request a waiver. | The last day to request a waiver is November 25.

supervisor.value: Admission is by the department; students do at least three lab rotations in year 1 and pick a thesis advisor by April 30.
supervisor.quote: Students complete a minimum of three lab rotations by March 31. | Students select a thesis advisor by April 30.

funding.value: BCS aims to fund all PhD students, whatever their citizenship, for their whole time at MIT (12-month stipend, tuition, health insurance); labs fund students after year 3.
funding.quote: The Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences aims to support all graduate students for their entire time of study at MIT, regardless of citizenship.

entry_route.value: MIT does not require a master's degree to apply for a PhD; you can apply from a bachelor's degree (final-year students may be admitted if the degree is awarded before enrolment).
entry_route.quote: The Institute does not require applicants to hold a master’s or other advanced degree in order to apply to a Ph.D program.

notes: Duolingo 135 accepted. Areas: cellular/molecular, systems and computational neuroscience and cognitive science. BCS participates in IDPS (statistics).
